Summary
Headline: The staff-facing kit is structurally solid - Getting Started Guide, Quick Reference Card, and Getting Better Results are ship-ready. Staff AI Tools Reference is the load-bearing failure - it lists STA Support Chat and AI Advisor as "Coming Soon" when both are Active, references three non-existent or deprecated projects, and points to "System Navigator" which has been superseded by AI Advisor. It needs a full rewrite before going to Chris, Tyler, Joanie, or anyone outside the SF cohort. AI System Overview Admin.html is documented as v4.15 (May 2) but The Architect is at v5.16 (May 20) - same magnitude of drift on the admin side, but admin docs only matter for Adam, so they don't block the cohort rollout.

Sequencing & Phasing
Order of operations for getting from "training kit ready" to "all 5 people active and using the tools."
0
Pre-launch fixes (this week, before any cohort comms go out)
Adam-only work
Lock the kit before anyone receives it. Sequence:
  • Fix the Coming Soon drift in Getting Started Guide + Quick Reference Card (mechanical, 30 min).
  • Rewrite Staff AI Tools Reference.html with current live/coming state, remove System Navigator references, drop Document Maker / Case Update Assistant / Work Assistant (2-3 hour rewrite).
  • Bump AI Rollout Plan to v2.0 reflecting current state and the named 5-person cohort (2-3 hour rewrite).
  • Update User Management Guide Power User row (mechanical, 10 min).
  • Write STA Support Chat one-pager for Chris & Tyler (1-2 hours).
  • Confirm AI_Tools_Getting_Started.pptx slide content matches the fixed HTML kit (verification + targeted slide edits).
1
Send the welcome wave (Day 1 of rollout)
~30 min to send
Two parallel sends:
  • Support track (Chris + Tyler): Welcome email with AUP, Restricted Data Guide, Getting Started Guide, STA Support Chat one-pager. Calendar a 30-min walk-through if Chris wants one - he's the lead so he can decide whether Tyler joins or gets it secondhand.
  • SF Cohort track (Tanya, Joanie, Kelsey): Welcome email (the existing SF Cohort Welcome Email Draft.md from the cohort blueprint folder) with AUP, Restricted Data Guide, Getting Started Guide, Cohort Getting Started.html, link to the project. They each open the project and run the Block 3 initialization prompt from project-launch.md.
2
First-week check-in (5-7 days after launch)
15-30 min per person
Light-touch follow-up - 1:1 or async per person preference. Goals: confirm they got logged in, get one real use-case they tried, surface any friction. Logging structure: feedback-log.md via the Agent Quality Logger skill if anything is off.
3
Cohort intake completion (weeks 2-3)
Cohort members complete on their own time
Kelsey + Joanie fill out STA Salesforce Org Intake.docx. Once complete, that drives v1.1 of context-sta-salesforce-org.md and the SF Cohort moves from Draft to Active in the registry. (This is the backlog workstream noted in the cohort's blueprint.)
4
Admin-side training doc cleanup (in parallel, no blocker)
Adam-only, run in the background
Rewrites of AI System Overview Admin.html and consolidation/cut of AI System Reference.md happen in parallel. These are Adam-facing reference docs only; the cohort never sees them. Doing this within the same month keeps Adam's own picture of the system trustworthy.
Decisions Needed From You
Before I start applying fixes, three calls:
  1. Approve the status assessment - especially the four Rewrite items (Staff AI Tools Reference, AI Rollout Plan v2.0, AI System Overview Admin, AI System Reference). Or push back on any I have wrong.
  2. Confirm the per-user rollout plan - any user-doc pairing you want to change? E.g., do you want Tanya to skip the SF Org Intake since Kelsey and Joanie will own it, or include her so she sees what's being captured?
  3. Pick what gets fixed first - my recommendation: the four Pre-launch Phase 0 items, in the order listed. Largest item is the AI Rollout Plan v2.0 rewrite. Tell me if you want me to start there, or somewhere else.
Once you give me the call, I'll work through fixes in batches and link each updated doc as I finish it. Estimate for the Phase 0 set: ~6-8 hours of work spread across however many sessions you want to run.
